profile.name: Name
profile.accountSafety1: Your account is managed by the school. Login credentials are your student ID and initial password. To change your password, please visit the Student Affairs Office or contact the system administrator.
profile.accountSafety2: Do not share your account and password with others. If you notice abnormal login activity, immediately inform your homeroom teacher or system administrator.
profile.accountSafety3: After each use, we recommend manually logging out on public devices to protect your personal information.
profile.dataVisibility1: Your service records, time coin balance, and progress are only visible to you, your homeroom teacher, and Student Development Center administrators.
profile.dataVisibility2: Aggregated statistics (without personal names) may be used for school volunteer service reports and public announcements.
profile.dataVisibility3: Approved activity proposal titles and basic information are displayed to all students in the Project Center.
profile.dataCollection1: Information collected by this system includes: service records, time, location, organization, evidence materials, and review records, used solely for volunteer service hour verification and management.
profile.dataCollection2: Uploaded evidence materials (images, PDF) are stored on school internal servers, not publicly accessible, retained for the duration of enrollment plus 3 years after graduation.
profile.dataCollection3: This system does not share your personal data with any third-party commercial organizations.
profile.rights1: You have the right to access all your service records and review history. If you find errors or disputes, you can file an appeal at the Audit Center or contact the Student Development Center directly.
profile.rights2: After graduation, you may request an export of your personal service records (PDF format). Please submit the request to an administrator before leaving school.
profile.rights3: If you have any questions about privacy protection, please email the Student Development Center or visit the H300 office in person.
profile.privacyFooter: This statement is formulated in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law of the People's Republic of China and Example City HD School Student Data Management Measures, last updated July 2026. Any policy changes will be announced via system notifications.
